en.name: Almond milk
en.summary: Almond milk is ground almonds pressed with water into a milk-like drink, sold either chilled or in shelf-stable cartons. The chilled kind belongs in the fridge and should be used by the date on the pack; once you open it, it runs about 7–10 days.
en.pantry: A shelf-stable carton that has not been opened can sit in a cool cupboard until its printed date, because it was sterilised and filled aseptically. Chilled cartons are a different product and must never be left out: treat them like dairy and follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Once any carton is opened, the cupboard is no longer an option.
en.fridge: Keep almond milk at 4 °C (40 °F) or below on an inside shelf, not in the door where the temperature swings every time someone opens it. Unopened chilled cartons go by the use-by date on the package. After opening, use it within 7–10 days, keeping the cap or spout closed and the carton upright. It separates as it stands; shake it before pouring, and judge it by smell rather than by the settling.
en.freezer: There is no published freezer timeline for almond milk, and freezing is rarely worth it: the emulsion breaks and the thawed drink is grainy and watery, no good in coffee or on cereal. If you have a carton you cannot finish, freeze it in an ice-cube tray at −18 °C (0 °F) and use the cubes in smoothies or baking, where the texture does not matter. Blend it well after thawing.
en.thawing: Thaw frozen almond-milk cubes in the fridge, never on the counter, and blend or shake hard before use. Expect separation; it will not come back completely.
spoilage: A sour, sharp or yeasty smell instead of the usual faint nutty one.
Thick lumps or curdled strands that do not disappear when you shake it.
A bulging carton, or a hiss and fizz when you open it.
A slimy or gluey pour, or any mould around the spout.
tips: Write the opening date on the carton; a week and a half passes quickly.
Buy small cartons if you only use it for coffee.
Never drink from the carton — backwash shortens its life sharply.
Keep it away from the fridge door and away from raw meat drips.

faq.q: How long does almond milk last after opening?
faq.a: About 7–10 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, whether it started as a chilled or a shelf-stable carton.

faq.q: Does unopened almond milk need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Chilled cartons do, and go by the use-by date on the pack. Aseptic shelf-stable cartons can stay in the cupboard until you open them.
You can, but there is no established timeline and it separates badly. Freeze it in cubes for smoothies and baking rather than for drinking.

faq.q: How can you tell if almond milk has gone bad?
faq.a: A sour or yeasty smell, lumps that will not shake out, a swollen carton or a fizz on opening all mean throw it away.

zh.name: 杏仁奶
zh.summary: 杏仁奶是把杏仁磨碎後加水榨壓而成的植物奶，市面上分冷藏和常溫利樂包兩種。冷藏的必須全程放冰箱，未開封時以包裝上的有效日期為準；開封之後大約可以放 7～10 天。
zh.pantry: 未開封的常溫利樂包可以放在陰涼的櫥櫃裡到標示日期，因為它經過滅菌並以無菌方式充填。冷藏包裝是另一種產品，絕對不能放在室溫：當成乳製品看待，遵守 2 小時原則（室溫超過 32 °C 時縮短為 1 小時）。任何一種包裝一旦開封，就不再有櫥櫃這個選項。
zh.fridge: 放在 4 °C 以下的內側層架，不要放門邊——門邊每開一次冰箱溫度就晃一次。未開封的冷藏包裝以包裝上的有效日期為準。開封後請在 7～10 天內喝完，蓋子或吸嘴要關緊、盒身直立。靜置後會分層，倒之前搖一搖；判斷好壞要靠氣味，不是靠有沒有沉澱。
zh.freezer: 杏仁奶沒有公告的冷凍期限，而且冷凍通常不划算：乳化狀態會被破壞，解凍後又粗又水，加咖啡或泡穀片都不行。真的喝不完，可以倒進製冰盒放 −18 °C，之後用在果昔或烘焙上，質地就不重要了。解凍後務必徹底攪打。
zh.thawing: 冷凍的杏仁奶冰磚請放冷藏解凍，不要放室溫，用之前用果汁機打勻或用力搖勻。分層是一定會發生的，而且不會完全回復。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸、刺鼻或有酵母味，而不是原本淡淡的堅果香。
出現搖不散的濃稠結塊或凝絮。
包裝鼓脹，或開封時有氣體嘶聲、冒泡。
倒起來黏稠牽絲，或吸嘴周圍長霉。
tips: 在盒身寫上開封日期；一個多星期過得比想像快。
如果只用來加咖啡，買小包裝就好。
不要直接就著盒口喝，口水回流會大幅縮短保存期。
放遠離冰箱門的位置，也要避開生肉可能滴落的下方。

faq.q: 杏仁奶開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 在 4 °C 以下大約 7～10 天，不管原本是冷藏包裝還是常溫利樂包都一樣。

faq.q: 未開封的杏仁奶一定要冰嗎？
faq.a: 冷藏包裝一定要，並以包裝有效日期為準。無菌充填的常溫利樂包在開封前可以放櫥櫃。
可以，但沒有對應的期限，而且解凍後分層嚴重。建議做成冰磚給果昔或烘焙用，不要指望拿來直接喝。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷杏仁奶壞掉了？
faq.a: 發酸或有酵母味、搖不散的結塊、包裝鼓脹、開封冒氣泡，任何一項都代表該丟了。
